newsitem.title: DENMARK: Den Danske falls after annual report.
newsitem.headline: Den Danske falls after annual report.

text.p: Den Danske Bank shares slipped by close to four percent on Thursday, despite the bank, Denmark's biggest, publishing 1996 results above analysts's expectations.
At 1050 GMT the share was down 24 crowns -- 3.89 percent -- to 593 crowns.

The bank announced full-year pre-tax profits of 5.396 billion crowns, down from 1995's six billion but well above an average forecast of 4.8 billion and not far off the most optimistic prediction of 5.77 billion. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +33969650
